description: Test suite for auto-responder functionality in Mattermost, including setting, disabling, and sending auto-responses in direct message channels and threads.

methods.name: TestSetAutoResponderStatus
methods.description: Tests enabling and disabling auto-responder status and verifying user status updates accordingly.

methods.name: TestDisableAutoResponder
methods.description: Tests disabling the auto-responder and verifying the user property updates.

methods.name: TestSendAutoResponseIfNecessary
methods.description: Tests the logic for sending auto-responses under various conditions, including enabled/disabled status, non-DM channels, bots, and recent responses.

methods.name: TestSendAutoResponseSuccess
methods.description: Verifies successful auto-response posting in a channel.

methods.name: TestSendAutoResponseSuccessOnThread
methods.description: Verifies auto-response posting in a thread (reply to a message).

methods.name: TestSendAutoResponseFailure
methods.description: Verifies that no auto-response is sent when conditions are not met.
